<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/copy_schema_message"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>

Copies a message from a schema file of a node the caller can open (workflow_guid, node_guid and file), or from the schema sent as from_schema, into the schema sent, exactly as it is there: segments, types and code sets this schema defines differently come in beside its own, and the message's matching rules with it. Nothing is written - the caller saves the schema - and nothing is run.
